attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"The Glimmer Coast Company reports a profitable week.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news from the previous bulletin and is not in the current briefing, so it is told as if current"},{"span":"The Tannerfolk and the Hollow Spire Pirates are fighting over the salt flats.","severity":"minor","reason":"repeats old news as a full item, not a short clause marking it as old"}],"voice":2,"clarity":3,"tone":3,"overall":2,"comment":"The bulletin pads a one-fact quiet week into four items, restating the lead twice and recycling old news and an old joke as current items; the voice is thin and repetitive.
